sentences.zh: 安妮，睁开眼睛。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪。

sentences.en: This is where I live.
sentences.zh: 这就是我住的地方。

sentences.en: I'm standing in Diane Gilman's new penthouse on the Upper East Side of Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 我正站在黛安·吉尔曼位于曼哈顿上东区的新顶层公寓里。

sentences.en: I knew that I'd be able to say that.
sentences.zh: 我知道我能说出这句话。

sentences.en: Penthouse, penthouse, penthouse, penthouse.
sentences.zh: 顶层公寓，顶层公寓，顶层公寓，顶层公寓。

sentences.en: It's a palace of fur and velvet in shades of taupe.
sentences.zh: 这是一个灰褐色调的皮草与天鹅绒宫殿。

sentences.en: I work with color all day long.
sentences.zh: 我整天都在跟颜色打交道。

sentences.en: I just didn't want to come home to color.
sentences.zh: 我只是不想回到一个充满色彩的家里。

sentences.en: Diane is a fashion designer.
sentences.zh: 黛安是一位时装设计师。

sentences.en: She's in her 70s, but she doesn't look like it.
sentences.zh: 她已经七十多岁了，但看起来一点也不像。

sentences.en: She's got big red hair and prominent cheekbones.
sentences.zh: 她有着一头蓬松的红发和突出的颧骨。

sentences.en: She's never been richer or happier, and she's definitely never owned a chair as cool as this one.
sentences.zh: 她从未像现在这样富有或快乐，而且她绝对从未拥有过像这把椅子这么酷的东西。

sentences.en: The whole lining around the chair are dried ostrich feathers, which one of my cats finds irresistibly delicious.
sentences.zh: 椅子周围的整个衬里都是干鸵鸟羽毛，我的其中一只猫对它们有着不可抗拒的喜爱。

sentences.en: But just a couple of decades ago, you wouldn't recognize Diane.
sentences.zh: 但就在几十年前，你绝对认不出黛安。

sentences.en: Now get ready to have fun and save money on the Home Shopping Channel.
sentences.zh: 现在准备好在电视购物频道享受乐趣并省钱吧。

sentences.en: I was in the backwater of fashion.
sentences.zh: 我当时处在时尚界的落后边缘。

sentences.en: And you look at yourself in the mirror and say, oh my God, how did I get to this point?
sentences.zh: 你看着镜子里的自己，心想，天哪，我怎么会落到这田地？

sentences.en: Most of us know the Home Shopping Network as the place you'd buy a thigh master or a flashy bracelet.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人都知道电视购物网络是个买大腿锻炼器或耀眼手镯的地方。

sentences.en: And back in 97, Diane's corner of this market was washable silk.
sentences.zh: 早在97年，黛安在这个市场占领的领域是水洗真丝。

sentences.en: Quite frankly, it was a little bit on the depressing side.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，这让人有点沮丧。

sentences.en: And I just thought to myself, really, is this how I envisaged my career?
sentences.zh: 我当时就在想，真的，这就是我设想中的职业生涯吗？

sentences.en: Of course, this is not how Diane had envisaged her career.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并不是黛安所设想的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Because Diane got her start designing jeans for rock and roll icons.
sentences.zh: 因为黛安最初是为摇滚乐巨星设计牛仔裤起家的。

sentences.en: I would take Janis Joplin's jeans or Jimi Hendrix's jeans or the Jefferson Airplane, and I would rip them, slash them, embroider them, hand paint them.
sentences.zh: 我会拿走珍尼斯·乔普林的牛仔裤、吉米·亨德里克斯的牛仔裤或者杰斐逊飞船乐队的牛仔裤，然后把它们撕破、割开、绣上花、手绘上图案。

sentences.en: I was known for making these great-looking jeans.
sentences.zh: 我以制作这些外观极棒的牛仔裤而闻名。

sentences.en: And for Diane, designing jeans was about more than the fashion.
sentences.zh: 对黛安来说，设计牛仔裤不仅仅关乎时尚。

sentences.en: It was a whole philosophy.
sentences.zh: 它是一种完整的哲学。

sentences.en: I was raised in a very repressive era in the 50s.
sentences.zh: 我在50年代一个非常压抑的时代长大。

sentences.en: I tried to wear jeans to high school.
sentences.zh: 我试图穿牛仔裤去高中。

sentences.en: I got sent home.
sentences.zh: 我被遣送回家了。

sentences.en: They were boys' clothing.
sentences.zh: 那是男人的衣服。

sentences.en: So I think the jeans were super symbolic of freedom, youth, and being wild.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为牛仔裤绝对象征着自由、青春和野性。

sentences.en: These jeans launched her career.
sentences.zh: 这些牛仔裤开启了她的职业生涯。

sentences.en: And soon, Diane was at the top of the fashion world.
sentences.zh: 很快，黛安就登上了时尚界的顶峰。

sentences.en: I remember being in a taxi and saying to the taxi driver, you see those windows?
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次坐在出租车里，对司机说，看到那些窗户了吗？

sentences.en: That's all my designs.
sentences.zh: 那全都是我的设计。

sentences.en: And then we would drive by Bloomingdale's, and I would say, and that's all my designs.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开过布鲁明代尔百货公司，我会说，还有那些全都是我的设计。

sentences.en: And then we would drive past Bonwet Tellers, and I said, oh, and that's my designs.
sentences.zh: 接着我们开过邦威特勒尔百货公司，我说，哦，那也是我的设计。

sentences.en: And then I signed a contract with a big Hong Kong consortium.
sentences.zh: 然后我与一家大型香港财团签了合同。

sentences.en: It didn't work out, basically because they didn't pay me.
sentences.zh: 结果并不顺利，主要是因为他们没有付钱给我。

sentences.en: And I lost my name for years.
sentences.zh: 我失去了我的名字好多年。

sentences.en: Diane lost the rights to her own name, which was also the name of her label.
sentences.zh: 黛安失去了自己名字的使用权，这也是她个人品牌的名字。

sentences.en: And that's when she landed at the Home Shopping Network, selling something called washable silk.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，她落脚于电视购物网络，开始售卖一种叫作水洗真丝的商品。

sentences.en: Clothes that look like silk, but don't have to be dry cleaned.
sentences.zh: 看起来像真丝但不需要干洗的衣服。

sentences.en: But this was the woman who made jeans for Jimi Hendrix and Janis Joplin.
sentences.zh: 但她可是那个曾为吉米·亨德里克斯和珍尼斯·乔普林制作牛仔裤的女人。

sentences.en: Diane had gotten so far away from that wild, free person she was back then.
sentences.zh: 黛安已经离当年那个野性、自由的自己越来越远了。

sentences.en: She didn't even wear jeans anymore.
sentences.zh: 她甚至不再穿牛仔裤了。

sentences.en: So I go at it, and I go to try and find a pair of jeans, and you go to some of the big category killer stores like The Gap, and nothing fits.
sentences.zh: 所以我去试着找一条牛仔裤，你去GAP这样的一些大型品类杀手店，结果什么都合身。

sentences.en: Okay, so then you start trying on men's jeans, and no, that's not really right.
sentences.zh: 好吧，然后你开始尝试男式牛仔裤，不，那其实并不合适。

sentences.en: In one store, she nearly has a breakdown when the saleswoman knocks on her fitting room door.
sentences.zh: 在一家店里，当女店员敲响她试衣间的门时，她几乎要崩溃了。

sentences.en: How you doing, hon?
sentences.zh: 你还好吗，亲爱的？

sentences.en: How the f*** do you think I'm doing?
sentences.zh: 你他妈觉得我好不好？

sentences.en: I've got a 32-inch waiSt.
sentences.zh: 我的腰围是32英寸。

sentences.en: I'm trying to stuff it into a jean that has a 27-inch waiSt.
sentences.zh: 我正试图把它塞进一条腰围只有27英寸的牛仔裤里。

sentences.en: I've got muffins built from here to Mars.
sentences.zh: 我从这到火星都堆满了赘肉。

sentences.en: I can't breathe, and no, I'm not feeling good, hon.
sentences.zh: 我喘不过气来，不，我感觉一点也不好，亲爱的。

sentences.en: Of course, it was more than just the jeans.
sentences.zh: 当然，这不仅仅是因为牛仔裤。

sentences.en: My husband died.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫去世了。

sentences.en: I gained all this weight.
sentences.zh: 我体重暴增。

sentences.en: I didn't love the product I was showing.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢我展示的产品。

sentences.en: It was sort of like everything hit at once.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像所有事情一下子全涌上来了。

sentences.en: I remember walking into Central Park, tears streaming down my eyes.
sentences.zh: 我记得走进中央公园，眼泪夺眶而出。

sentences.en: I thought, okay, what am I going to do here with the rest of my life?
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，我接下来的人生该怎么办？

sentences.en: And the thing she did next changed everything for her.
sentences.zh: 她接下来做的事改变了她的一切。

sentences.en: I took out a crumpled napkin, and I decided to write down everything I hated about my life, long liSt.
sentences.zh: 我掏出一张揉皱的餐巾纸，决定写下我讨厌生活中的什么，列了长长的一单。

sentences.en: Everything I liked about my life, super short list, and what I was going to do about it.
sentences.zh: 还有我喜欢生活中的什么，列了超级短的一单，以及我打算怎么做。

sentences.en: And I wanted something more out of my talent than just designing washable silk.
sentences.zh: 我对自己的才华有所期待，不只是设计水洗真丝。

sentences.en: What do I really want?
sentences.zh: 我真正想要什么？

sentences.en: I want to design jeans.
sentences.zh: 我想设计牛仔裤。

sentences.en: She started by measuring herself.
sentences.zh: 她从给自己量尺寸开始。

sentences.en: The first jean I designed, I had my sewing room sew it up.
sentences.zh: 我设计的第一个牛仔裤，我让我的缝纫室缝制了出来。

sentences.en: And did you actually, like, fit the jeans to your actual body?
sentences.zh: 你真的，就像是根据你实际的身体来裁剪牛仔裤吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm the fit model.
sentences.zh: 我就是版型模特。

sentences.en: They were stretchy, with a wider waist and a slimmer leg.
sentences.zh: 它们很有弹性，腰围更宽，裤腿更修身。

sentences.en: And I remember walking down the street, and two guys were working in a manhole.
sentences.zh: 我记得走在街上，有两个家伙在一个地下井里干活。

sentences.en: Both of them stood up out of that manhole, looked at me.
sentences.zh: 他们俩从那个地下井里直起身子，看着我。

sentences.en: One of them whistled, and the other one said, beautiful.
sentences.zh: 其中一个吹了声口哨，另一个说，真美。

sentences.en: And I said to myself, wow, this feels really good.
sentences.zh: 我对自己说，哇，这感觉真好。

sentences.en: So Diane convinced the Home Shopping Network to let her try an experiment, making jeans for older women like her.
sentences.zh: 于是黛安说服电视购物网络让她尝试一个实验，为像她这样的老年女性制作牛仔裤。

sentences.en: The factories kept saying, wait a minute, these measurements, is this a typo?
sentences.zh: 工厂一直在说，等一下，这些尺寸，这是笔误吗？

sentences.en: You want a 32-inch waist on a size A?
sentences.zh: 你想在A码上做32英寸的腰围？

sentences.en: And I said, yeah, I want a 32-inch waiSt.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，我就要32英寸的腰围。

sentences.en: And then the big day arrived.
sentences.zh: 然后，重大日子来临了。

sentences.en: But there were some probleMs.
sentences.zh: 但出现了一些问题。

sentences.en: First of all, Diane was not selling on primetime.
sentences.zh: 首先，黛安并非在黄金时段销售。

sentences.en: Who wants to get up at 5 a.m.
sentences.zh: 谁会想在早上5点起床

sentences.en: to watch a tele-retailing show?
sentences.zh: 去看电视零售节目？

sentences.en: I mean, come on.
sentences.zh: 我是说，拜托。

sentences.en: Plus, Diane had planned to sell the jeans alongside shirts and accessories, but...
sentences.zh: 另外，黛安原本计划将牛仔裤与衬衫和配饰一起销售，但是……

sentences.en: The container ship, I don't know, it must have been a storm at sea, but the only thing that got through to the warehouse were the jeans.
sentences.zh: 那艘集装箱货轮，我不知道，海上肯定有风暴，但唯一运抵仓库的东西只有牛仔裤。

sentences.en: And I remember sitting in bed crying and saying, nobody's going to buy it because there's nothing to go with it.
sentences.zh: 我记得自己坐在床上哭泣，说没人会买，因为没有东西可以搭配它。

sentences.en: Oh my God, this is so horrible.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这太糟糕了。

sentences.en: That morning, she got up, pulled on a pair of her jeans, and drove to the studio.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，她起床，穿上一条牛仔裤，然后开车去了演播室。

sentences.en: And we went on air.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始直播了。

sentences.en: Diane's standing next to a rack of jeans.
sentences.zh: 黛安正站在一排牛仔裤旁。

sentences.en: She shows the audience the pair she's wearing, the stretchy waist, how she's not spilling over the top.
sentences.zh: 她向观众展示她身上穿的那条，有彈性的腰头，还有她穿起来完全没有勒出赘肉。

sentences.en: And when it goes from, like, 25 people ordering to, like, 600 people ordering...
sentences.zh: 当订单量从比如25人猛增到大约600人时……

sentences.en: I thought, okay, there's something huge going on here.
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，这里有什么了不得的事情正在发生。

sentences.en: And they sold out at 5 in the morning within minutes.
sentences.zh: 它们在早上5点钟几分钟内就卖光了。

sentences.en: And that was just the beginning.
sentences.zh: 而这只是个开始。

sentences.en: More than 102,000 pair of her Fabulous Today specials have been ordered.
sentences.zh: 她的“今日绝妙好物”特卖商品已经售出了102,000多条。

sentences.en: If you haven't called yet...
sentences.zh: 如果你还没打电话……

sentences.en: Now, Diane is one of the Home Shopping Network's most successful sellers.
sentences.zh: 如今，黛安是家庭购物频道最成功的卖家之一。

sentences.en: Because you know something, Gina?
sentences.zh: 因为你知道吗，吉娜？

sentences.en: We love what we're wearing.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢我们穿的衣服。

sentences.en: Ten million jeans later, I realized that that list was the most important tool I could have in life.
sentences.zh: 在售出千万条牛仔裤之后，我意识到那份清单是我一生中拥有的最重要的工具。

sentences.en: And I still go back and look at it.
sentences.zh: 我至今仍会回头去看看它。

sentences.en: Pardon me, I'm hiccuping.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，我在打嗝。

sentences.en: When I get excited, I start hiccuping.
sentences.zh: 当我兴奋的时候，我就会开始打嗝。

sentences.en: And when she's not on TV selling jeans, Diane's in her Upper East Side penthouse.
sentences.zh: 当不上电视卖牛仔裤的时候，黛安就在她位于上东区的顶层公寓里。

sentences.en: Somebody threw up a little here.
sentences.zh: 有人在这里吐了一点。

sentences.en: With her cats and her ostrich chair.
sentences.zh: 和她的猫以及鸲鹋羽毛椅子在一起。

sentences.en: I think maybe we just ate one too many ostrich feathers off the chair.
sentences.zh: 我想也许我们刚刚从椅子上吃了一根太多的鸲鹋羽毛。

sentences.en: Reporter Annie Brown.
sentences.zh: 记者安妮·布朗。

sentences.en: When we come back, we'll return to Aline and do a little experiment to see if Diane's story can help her.
sentences.zh: 当我们回来时，我们将回到艾琳身边，做一个小实验，看看黛安的故事能否对她有所帮助。

sentences.en: Support for Change Agent comes from Comcast Business.
sentences.zh: 《变革推动者》由康卡斯特商业赞助。

sentences.en: As a business owner, every meeting, presentation, and project is critical for your growth.
sentences.zh: 作为一名企业主，每一次会议、演示和项目对你的成长都至关重要。

sentences.en: That's why you need a fast, reliable connection that lets your business dream big.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你需要一个快速、可靠的网络，让你的商业梦想能够放飞。

sentences.en: Comcast Business is offering gig speed internet across their network, allowing for speeds up to 20 times faster than what most people have.
sentences.zh: 康卡斯特商业正在其网络中提供千兆宽带，其速度比大多数人拥有的速度快高达20倍。

sentences.en: That's seamless connectivity.
sentences.zh: 这就是无缝连接。

sentences.en: More connected devices and downloads in seconds instead of minutes.
sentences.zh: 更多连接的设备，以及在几秒钟而非几分钟内完成下载。

sentences.en: Visit business.comcaSt.com to learn how your business can get on the gig speed network.
sentences.zh: 访问business.comcast.com，了解您的企业如何接入千兆网络。

sentences.en: Restriction supply compares gig speed to 50 megabits per second downloads.
sentences.zh: 限制条件适用，千兆速度与每秒50兆字节的下载速度进行比较。

sentences.en: Actual speeds may vary.
sentences.zh: 实际速度可能会有所不同。

sentences.en: I wish I had met somebody like Diane years ago.
sentences.zh: 我真希望几年前能遇到像黛安这样的人。

sentences.en: We're back with Aline.
sentences.zh: 我们和艾琳一起回来了。

sentences.en: So if a list really helped Diane figure out what she wanted, we thought Aline should start there.
sentences.zh: 所以，既然清单确实帮助黛安弄清楚了她想要什么，我们认为艾琳应该从那里开始。

sentences.en: This is what I love.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所热爱的。

sentences.en: First, you list out the things you love about your life.
sentences.zh: 首先，你列出你生活中喜爱的事物。

sentences.en: What I love is music.
sentences.zh: 我喜爱的是音乐。

sentences.en: I love willow trees.
sentences.zh: 我喜爱垂柳。

sentences.en: I love men with a sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 我喜爱有幽默感的男人。

sentences.en: Pretty much.
sentences.zh: 差不多吧。

sentences.en: I like men all together.
sentences.zh: 我总的来说挺喜欢男人的。

sentences.en: I love massages and dancing and reading.
sentences.zh: 我喜爱按摩、跳舞和阅读。

sentences.en: And soaking in the tub.
sentences.zh: 还有泡澡。

sentences.en: And then the things you hate.
sentences.zh: 然后是你厌恶的事物。

sentences.en: My living arrangement at the moment.
sentences.zh: 我目前的居住安排。

sentences.en: Not having a purpose in life.
sentences.zh: 生活中没有目标。

sentences.en: Negative people.
sentences.zh: 负能量的人。

sentences.en: I want to be around people who feel good about life.
sentences.zh: 我想和对生活感觉良好的人在一起。

sentences.en: God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And finally, the big question.
sentences.zh: 最后，是那个重大问题。

sentences.en: What you want.
sentences.zh: 你想要什么。

sentences.en: Well, obviously, I want to be doing something that makes me happy.
sentences.zh: 好吧，很显然，我想做一些能让我快乐的事。

sentences.en: I want to be helpful to people.
sentences.zh: 我想对人们有所帮助。

sentences.en: There's a lot of sad people in the senior center that I belong to.
sentences.zh: 在我所在的那个高级中心里有很多悲伤的人。

sentences.en: So I guess it made me start to think of hand massage.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这让我开始考虑手部按摩。

sentences.en: Did you ever have a massage on your hands?
sentences.zh: 你做过手部按摩吗？

sentences.en: I don't think I've ever gotten a hand massage.
sentences.zh: 我想我从来没做过手部按摩。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: It feels 10 times better than how good it feels on your back.
sentences.zh: 它的感觉比背部按摩要好上十倍。

sentences.en: But older people don't like to be touched very much.
sentences.zh: 但老年人不太喜欢别人过多地触碰他们。

sentences.en: And I go around to hug people when I'm at the senior center.
sentences.zh: 我在高级中心时会到处去拥抱别人。

sentences.en: I'm lucky if I can get two hugs.
sentences.zh: 如果能得到两个拥抱，我就很幸运了。

sentences.en: And in the process of making this list, Aline realized it's not just about what she wants to do.
sentences.zh: 在制作这份清单的过程中，艾琳意识到这不仅仅关乎她想做什么。

sentences.en: It's about who she wants to be.
sentences.zh: 这关乎她想成为什么样的人。

sentences.en: I was not a very expressive person.
sentences.zh: 我过去不是一个很会表达的人。

sentences.en: But what opened up when I had this relationship with Larry was a freedom of speaking how I felt.
sentences.zh: 但我和拉里建立这种关系后所敞开心扉的，是一种说出自己感受的自由。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Yeah?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: I want that.
sentences.zh: 我想要那个。

sentences.en: I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎。

sentences.en: Hey, I wanted this by myself.
sentences.zh: 嘿，这是我靠自己想要的。

sentences.en: I don't want another person to have to give it to me.
sentences.zh: 我不想让另一个人必须把它施舍给我。

sentences.en: So, here's the plan.
sentences.zh: 所以，计划是这样的。

sentences.en: A month or two ago, I really thought I needed to confront him and say, hey, you kind of trampled on my heart.
sentences.zh: 一两个月前，我真的以为我需要去质问他，对他说，嘿，你有点践踏了我的心。

sentences.en: But I don't feel that way anymore.
sentences.zh: 但我不再那样觉得了。

sentences.en: Aline is going on her annual trip to visit her son in Washington State.
sentences.zh: 艾琳正前往华盛顿州进行她每年探望儿子的旅行。

sentences.en: And she's going to talk to Larry, the guy who started this whole thing.
sentences.zh: 她要去跟拉里谈谈，那个引发了这一切的家伙。

sentences.en: And the goal isn't to get him back, but to embrace this new way of being open and expressing herself.
sentences.zh: 我们的目的不是要挽回他，而是去拥抱这种开放和表达自我的全新生活方式。

sentences.en: To let him know how I felt, but also let him know that the effect he had on me, which was good.
sentences.zh: 让他知道我的感受，同时也让他知道他对我的影响是正面的。

sentences.en: And I would love for us still to be friends.
sentences.zh: 而且我很乐意我们依然能做朋友。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Which is how reporter Annie Brown ended up in a car outside a senior center in Washington.
sentences.zh: 这就是记者安妮·布朗最终来到华盛顿一家高级中心外的汽车里的原因。

sentences.en: It's Thursday.
sentences.zh: 今天是星期四。

sentences.en: That means bridge day at the Bonnie Lake Senior Center.
sentences.zh: 这意味着邦尼湖高级中心的桥牌日。

sentences.en: And Larry never misses a bridge game.
sentences.zh: 而拉里从不错过任何一场桥牌局。

sentences.en: How are you feeling?
sentences.zh: 你感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Couldn't make up my mind what to wear.
sentences.zh: 拿不定主意穿什么。

sentences.en: So I wore what I wore yesterday.
sentences.zh: 所以我穿了昨天穿的衣服。

sentences.en: Aline is wearing a loose black sweatshirt and a large medallion necklace.
sentences.zh: 艾琳穿着一件宽松的黑色运动衫和一条大大的奖章项链。

sentences.en: Actually, this is my sexy outfit.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这是我的性感装扮。

sentences.en: The plan is to catch Larry after his bridge game.
sentences.zh: 计划是在拉里打完桥牌后抓住他。

sentences.en: It's 9.30 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 现在是早上9点半。

sentences.en: And Larry's bridge game isn't until 1.
sentences.zh: 而拉里的桥牌局要到1点才开始。

sentences.en: But we want to be early.
sentences.zh: 但我们想早点到。

sentences.en: And he doesn't know that we're coming today.
sentences.zh: 而且他不知道我们今天要来。

sentences.en: No, I couldn't get a hold of him.
sentences.zh: 对，我联系不上他。

sentences.en: Yeah, I couldn't either.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也联系不上。

sentences.en: I tried calling him and emailing him.
sentences.zh: 我试过给他打电话和发电子邮件。

sentences.en: Turns out Larry's pretty hard to get a hold of.
sentences.zh: 事实证明拉里挺难联系上的。

sentences.en: He doesn't have a cell phone.
sentences.zh: 他没有手机。

sentences.en: And he disconnected his landline after he moved into his new wife's house.
sentences.zh: 搬进他新婚妻子的房子后，他把座机也停机了。

sentences.en: We go inside.
sentences.zh: 我们走了进去。

sentences.en: Around 10.30, we have lunch.
sentences.zh: 大约10点半，我们吃午饭。

sentences.en: And then we play cards and visit until the bridge game starts.
sentences.zh: 然后我们玩牌、聊天，直到桥牌局开始。

sentences.en: And we're pretty sure he's going to show.
sentences.zh: 而且我们确信他会现身。

sentences.en: Nothing keeps him away from playing bridge.
sentences.zh: 没有什么能阻止他打桥牌。

sentences.en: About an hour into the game, still no Larry.
sentences.zh: 牌局开始约一个小时后，依然不见拉里的踪影。

sentences.en: What are we going to do if he doesn't show up?
sentences.zh: 如果他不出现，我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm just thinking the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚也在想同样的事。

sentences.en: What if he doesn't show up?
sentences.zh: 万一他不出现呢？

sentences.en: The son of a bitch.
sentences.zh: 这个混蛋。

sentences.en: The bridge game's over.
sentences.zh: 桥牌局结束了。

sentences.en: So as a last resort, Aline asks someone at the Senior Center, for Larry's new number.
sentences.zh: 所以作为最后手段，艾琳向高级中心里的某个人询问拉里的新号码。

sentences.en: So we'll try the home number.
sentences.zh: 那我们打这个家里的号码试试。

sentences.en: And she calls from the car.
sentences.zh: 她在车里打了电话。

sentences.en: Here goes nothing.
sentences.zh: 豁出去了。

sentences.en: They're out.
sentences.zh: 他们不在。

sentences.en: I'll leave a message.
sentences.zh: 我留个言吧。

sentences.en: Okay, I'm trying to find Larry.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我正在找拉里。

sentences.en: I know he's hiding there someplace.
sentences.zh: 我知道他肯定藏在哪个地方。

sentences.en: Just wanted to talk to him for a bit.
sentences.zh: 只想跟他聊一会儿。

sentences.en: Oh, you're there.
sentences.zh: 哦，你在那儿呀。

sentences.en: Son of a gun.
sentences.zh: 好家伙。

sentences.en: I thought I'd see you at the Center today.
sentences.zh: 我还以为今天能在中心见到你呢。

sentences.en: Ah.
sentences.zh: 啊。

sentences.en: Well, listen.
sentences.zh: 那听着。

sentences.en: Would you and a Red Electric come to an ice cream store or a coffee shop or something?
sentences.zh: 你和瑞德·埃里克要不要去冰淇淋店、咖啡馆或者什么地方坐坐？

sentences.en: Oh, great.
sentences.zh: 哦，太好了。

sentences.en: When?
sentences.zh: 什么时候？

sentences.en: This afternoon?
sentences.zh: 今天下午？

sentences.en: Now?
sentences.zh: 现在？

sentences.en: Baskin Robbins.
sentences.zh: 巴斯金·罗宾斯冰淇淋店。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: That's perfect.
sentences.zh: 那太完美了。

sentences.en: I'll see you there.
sentences.zh: 我在那儿等你。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: A few minutes after we get to Baskin Robbins,
sentences.zh: 在我们到达巴斯金·罗宾斯几分钟后，

sentences.en: Larry and his wife push through the door, laughing.
sentences.zh: 拉里和他的妻子笑着推门而入。

sentences.en: Aline is quiet and gives Larry a hug.
sentences.zh: 艾琳很安静，给了拉里一个拥抱。

sentences.en: He's tall.
sentences.zh: 他很高。

sentences.en: He's got a big white beard and a worn-in trucker hat.
sentences.zh: 他留着一大把白胡子，戴着一顶磨损的卡车司机帽。

sentences.en: She wants a cherry cone.
sentences.zh: 她想吃一个樱桃甜筒。

sentences.en: His wife sits down while Larry orders.
sentences.zh: 当拉里点单时，他妻子坐了下来。

sentences.en: What's on there?
sentences.zh: 那上面有什么？

sentences.en: This is Scudder Botch and...
sentences.zh: 这是斯卡德·博奇还有……

sentences.en: Scudder Botch?
sentences.zh: 斯卡德·博奇？

sentences.en: Is that what you called it?
sentences.zh: 你是这么叫它的吗？

sentences.en: Did I get it backwards again?
sentences.zh: 我是不是又弄反了？

sentences.en: I must have had it backwards.
sentences.zh: 我一定是弄反了。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.en: Larry and his wife seem relaxed.
sentences.zh: 拉里和他的妻子看起来很轻松。

sentences.en: They're happy to see Aline.
sentences.zh: 他们很高兴见到艾琳。

sentences.en: We get a table.
sentences.zh: 我们找了张桌子坐下。

sentences.en: They all talk about their grandkids for a while.
sentences.zh: 他们聊了一会儿各自的孙辈。

sentences.en: And Aline's lemon ice cream is almost completely melted before.
sentences.zh: 艾琳的柠檬冰淇淋几乎完全融化了，在...

sentences.en: But anyway, I must have really been depressed all last winter before I came out here.
sentences.zh: 不过不管怎样，去年冬天我来这里之前，我肯定真的很沮丧。

sentences.en: But then, talking to you, I felt so much better.
sentences.zh: 但后来，跟你聊过后，我感觉好多了。

sentences.en: You gave me a lot of confidence in myself.
sentences.zh: 你让我对自己的信心大增。

sentences.en: And I have to say, I was very sad when he stopped because he met you.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，当他停下来因为遇到了你时，我很难过。

sentences.en: I was very sad.
sentences.zh: 我真的很难过。

sentences.en: But I've grown up so much that now, I can say with a full and open heart, I don't need one person to make me feel this way all the time.
sentences.zh: 但我成长了太多，现在我可以满怀欣喜地对你说，我不再需要某一个人来让我时时刻刻都有这种感觉。

sentences.en: If I'm doing something that makes me happy, it's dripping.
sentences.zh: 如果我在做让我高兴的事，它就会滴下来。

sentences.en: A drop of ice cream falls into Larry's beard.
sentences.zh: 一滴冰淇淋落在了拉里的胡子上。

sentences.en: I stay close by him so I can take care of him.
sentences.zh: 我离他很近，这样我可以照顾他。

sentences.en: His wife, Aretta, dabs it clean with a napkin.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子阿丽塔用餐巾纸把它擦干净了。

sentences.en: She is handy.
sentences.zh: 她很能干。

sentences.en: Be gentle now.
sentences.zh: 现在温柔点。

sentences.en: Yeah, so this is what I came up with to begin with.
sentences.zh: 对，所以这就是我最初的想法。

sentences.en: What I want to do is give hand massages, especially to the older people, especially the people in senior centers.
sentences.zh: 我想做的是提供手部按摩，特别是给老年人，尤其是养老中心的人。

sentences.en: You know, we're old.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们老了。

sentences.en: Our hands are...
sentences.zh: 我们的手...

sentences.en: Get stiff.
sentences.zh: 变僵硬了。

sentences.en: Yeah, they get stiff.
sentences.zh: 对，它们变僵硬了。

sentences.en: And at some point, Larry turns to me and says...
sentences.zh: 就在某个时刻，拉里转向我对我说...

sentences.en: She's a totally different person now.
sentences.zh: 她现在完全变了个人。

sentences.en: She was kind of quiet, standoffish.
sentences.zh: 她以前有点安静，冷淡。

sentences.en: Now she's bubbly, forward.
sentences.zh: 现在她很活泼，很外向。

sentences.en: He says that a few years ago when he met Aline, he only saw a glimmer of this person.
sentences.zh: 他说几年前他遇到艾琳时，只看到了这个人的一点影子。

sentences.en: As I remember her, there's a person inside that is not as seen as often.
sentences.zh: 据我记忆中的她，内心深处有一个不那么常常见到的人。

sentences.en: But I just tell by looking at her now, she's sneaking out.
sentences.zh: 但我现在看着她就能看出，她正在悄悄走出来。

sentences.en: Pretty soon, Aline takes Aretta's hand.
sentences.zh: 很快，艾琳拉住了阿丽塔的手。

sentences.en: Aretta, when I told you that if he loves you, then I love you, I meant it with my whole heart.
sentences.zh: 阿丽塔，当我告诉你如果他爱你，那我也爱你时，我是发自内心地说的。

sentences.en: Then Larry puts his hand on top of theirs.
sentences.zh: 然后拉里把手叠在他们手上。

sentences.en: I'm too old to be so serious about everything.
sentences.zh: 我太老了，没必要对所有事都那么认真。

sentences.en: And they just sit there.
sentences.zh: 他们就坐在那里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: These three 80-year-olds, holding hands and chatting about their futures.
sentences.zh: 这三个八十岁的老人，手拉着手，聊着他们的未来。

sentences.en: I can't get hugs.
sentences.zh: 我得不到拥抱。

sentences.en: And so...
sentences.zh: 所以...

sentences.en: You're not hugs.
sentences.zh: 你不是那种需要拥抱的人。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: You need at least four a day.
sentences.zh: 你一天至少需要四个。

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对的。

sentences.en: At leaSt.
sentences.zh: 至少。

sentences.en: That's the thing.
sentences.zh: 关键就在这里。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后呢...

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: We're back in the car.
sentences.zh: 我们回到车里。

sentences.en: How are you feeling right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm feeling great.
sentences.zh: 我感觉棒极了。

sentences.en: It was easier to say than I thought it would be.
sentences.zh: 这比我想象的要容易说出口。

sentences.en: I might not have been able to say it if it was the old me.
sentences.zh: 如果还是以前的我，我可能根本说不出来。

sentences.en: I wouldn't have exposed myself.
sentences.zh: 我不会向别人袒露自己。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 但你做到了。

sentences.zh: 我做到了。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我真的做到了。

sentences.zh: 我做到了。

sentences.en: Didn't I?
sentences.zh: 不是吗？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Aline went home from her trip, her list in hand.
sentences.zh: 艾琳结束旅行回到家，手里拿着她的清单。

sentences.en: She got a lesson from her niece, who's a massage therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 她向身为按摩治疗师的侄女请教了一课。

sentences.en: And the senior center told her she can start giving hand massages anytime she wants.
sentences.zh: 养老中心告诉她，她随时都可以开始提供手部按摩。
